headline: Forcing query plans in PostgreSQL 19 severely reduced speed
body: Tests of PostgreSQL 19 RC2's pg_plan_advice revealed forced plans cut throughput ninefold with ten clients. The default planner outperformed forced plans in every tested scenario.
caption:
Forcing query plans in PostgreSQL 19 severely reduced speed

Tests of PostgreSQL 19 RC2's pg_plan_advice revealed forced plans cut throughput ninefold with ten clients. The default planner outperformed forced plans in every tested scenario.
